prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. New GDD enemy BODY animation: Huyết Phù Sư, exact southwest: front three-quarter lower LEFT in every pose.
Image1 OWN inspected SAME-VIEW neutral is PRIMARY motion/camera target and identity. Image2 live Wang is the direct PRIMARY human anatomy/pixel standard; keep OWN face, hair, age, clothing and approved body proportions. Only requested SAME-VIEW images are provided: inherit approved identity through the own-view lineage, never borrow another camera.
Identity: OWN approved stern human blood-talisman mage, high tied dark hair and red seal textiles. Preserve approved hair silhouette and crimson/ivory/dark palette; never switch to Wang clothing.
Exactly FOUR COLUMNS x FOUR ROWS, SIXTEEN complete isolated figures on2048x1536. Each has spacious512x384 area;80px truly transparent outer margins and80px clear gutters between ALL hair/hand/robe/body edges. Never expand figures to fill cells. ROWS1+2: eight identical own standing/floating neutral calibration figures. ROWS3+4: eight ordered hit figures: composed ready / shoulder recoils / strongest torso recoil with hair trailing / torso rebounds / hands settle / composed ready / own ready rest in same view / own ready rest in same view.
ONE scale for the complete source from the neutral calibration, nominal 80 native pixels. Keep own skull/armor dimensions throughout. Lean, compression, crouch and fall lower the pose naturally; never fit per-pose height. Keep actual camera and anatomical rear occlusion in all actions. Rear hands do not show through torso, mantle or hair.
Compact attached hands/fingers for human/spirit; complete heavy stone fists for construct. Both actual stone feet/boots stay attached where applicable; spectral character has NO boots or invented walking legs. No mirrored view or flipped costume. All figures isolated by generous transparent gutters, with ample margins for complete hair, fists and prone body on all edges.
Truly transparent RGBA, crisp stepped pixel contours and limited shade bands. Body/outfit only; no floor, shadow, captions, grid, held weapon, projectile, detached shards, duplicate actor, warning ring, spell glow, smoke, aura or external FX. Solid own body, truthful physical foot contact.
FINAL CAMERA AUTHORITY for southwest: copy Image1 orientation into ALL 18 figures, including neutral calibration, recoil, wind-up and low poses. Show the exact front/diagonal head and torso from Image1, with correct face/chest, never the other diagonal. Preserve own hair/skull, material, attached limbs and body build exactly from Image1, including any own hair tuft/tie; descriptive hair shorthand never overrides the actual inspected identity. No mirror, fitting, external prop or FX.

SPACIOUS SOURCE: every calibration and action body complete and fully inside image; no hand can touch neighboring hair. Same source-wide scale and requested own camera in all16 figures. Rear N/NE/NW hide face/pupils; front-of-sternum command hands are naturally occluded by torso from rear, never clasp behind the back or show skin on the back belt. Release arm may clear shoulder silhouette. Keep attached wrists and grouped fingers. No mirror, fit, pixel painting or external FX.
